review_text: Das Haus war leicht zu finden, das Zimmer selbst war super sauber und alles in Ordnung, daher empfehlenswert. Wie andere schon geschrieben haben, muss der Checkin über eine App gemacht werden und die App muss dann auch weiterhin verwendet werden um die Türen zu öffnen. Es war ein wenig umständlich, aber wir waren gut vorbereitet und alles hat funktioniert. Everything was wonderful! The apartment has it all and was spotless. But the staff deserves 6 stars: attentive, dedicated, and super kind. They even picked up a delivery I ordered. I felt taken care of in every detail. 100% recommended. Had a wonderful stay during my recent trip to Singapore. The check-in process was smooth and hassle-free, which made a great first impression. The staff were incredibly friendly and always ready to help with anything I needed. The location was perfect—very convenient for getting around and exploring the city. The place itself was spotless and well-maintained, which I really appreciated. I truly enjoyed my stay and would love to come back again. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Singapore! Great Location with Some Safety Concerns The location is absolutely fantastic - incredibly convenient for exploring the city. A lot of places are within walking distance.There's an excellent restaurant called Sing Swee Kee nearby that we enjoyed, and a convenience store just 200 meters away was very handy for daily essentials. However, I must mention two important safety concerns. First, the bathroom lacks a non-slip mat, which is quite dangerous. I nearly slipped and fell one day, and I strongly recommend the host install proper anti-slip facilities to prevent accidents. Second, regarding luggage storage on our final day: while the host allowed us to store bags until 6 PM, when we returned at 2:30 PM to collect them, we found our luggage simply placed in the second-floor hallway. This raised serious security concerns - having personal belongings left unattended in a public corridor doesn't feel safe at all. Hope the host can provide a more secure solution. Der Aufenthalt in Heritage Collection war unkompliziert, in einer super Lage und wirklich klasse! Das Zimmer ist sauber und bietet für zwei Personen genug Platz. Ein großes Dankeschön auch an Divina, Macia und Rome die uns bei Fragen oder Problemen direkt geholfen haben. Vielen Dank ich komme gerne wieder 👍🏼 Lovely place great location and very comfortable bed ,highly recommended Had an amazing stay and everyone was super helpful and kind! The hotel conceirge was helpful, even though they are not on site, they always replied on what's app very quickly. Every thing was clean and comfortable. Excellent location, and the team responds quickly. I recommend it for a short stay! It is not a terrible place to stay but I was counting the days until I was able to check out. I won't be back. Pros: -Good internet -Good location, quieter than it looks -Great washing machines and dryers -Nice staff (but see below) Cons: -Absolutely bloody terrible value for money: all the negatives of a hotel room and all the negatives of a "serviced" apartment -Too small, for example there is no separate sink in the bathroom and you must used the one in the kitchen -Checkin experience is odd: slow replies from the host, no clarity on whether early check in was possible (in the end it was but took hours for them to tell me even yes or no on the day) -They say you can leave your luggage in the building while waiting to check in, but there is no storage whatsoever. I had to leave mine in the hallway. -Spotty cleaning, with dust and hairs left behind -Kitchen not very well equipped -Stingy with towels, if you stay make sure you chase them for a couple more. The location was also a huge plus, with easy access to restaurants, shops, and public transportation. Whether I was exploring the area or just relaxing, the convenience made everything stress-free. The host was responsive and welcoming, adding to the great experience. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and well-located place! Checkin experience was not great but the room was good overall. Clean, comfy and good value for money.

Support from Mary and rome was super helpful. From check in to checkout it was a too smooth process. Property is at perfect location with views of MBS and just at the right party spots. Very convenient and accessible from cityhall mrt. Das Heritage Collection on Boat Quay (South Bridge Wing) hat eine super Lage mit Zimmern Richtung Flußseite. Obwohl diese Appartements (von mehreren in der Stadt) in einer sehr belebten Gegend sind (Restaurants und Bars bis 3 Uhr nachts geöffnet) hat man auf den Zimmern eigentlich seine Ruhe. Viele MRT Stationen sind super zu Fuß erreichbar und bringen einen an alle wichtigen Orte in Singapur. Besonders gut war die freundliche und unkomplizierte Kommunikation über whats app mit den Mitarbeitern. Gepäckaufbewahrung ist ebenfalls sicher und zuverlässig aufbewahrt. Wir sind vollends zufrieden mit der Wahl dieses Heritage Collection Hotels. We stayed at Heritage Collection for almost a week and had a fantastic stay! The location was great and close to public transportation and a wide variety of restaurants. The overall room was lovely with a great view of the waterfront! In terms of getting there, please be sure to double check which location you'll be staying at, as there are two locations within in the area. The instructions were very clear so we were able to navigate to the location quickly. Regarding the noise levels, we felt the noise wasn't as prominent, but rather vibrations from the rooftop bar, especially during the evening on weekends. We were fully aware of this prior to our arrival so we brought earplugs just in case! Overall, loved the convenient access and great location and would definitely stay here again next trip! Thank you, Heritage Collection team! Extended my stay because I loved the place. Mary, Shannen, Rome was great as always. Attentive, helpful and friendly. It was very clean and tidy and the staff were friendly. The location is great and as mentioned can be a bit noisy. I took ear plugs and had no issues sleeping with the noise whatsoever Great place to stay if you enjoy the nightlife. Bars and restaurants are right downstairs. Also, the staff Mary, Maybelle, Edmar, Shannen and Rome were amazing. So do be aware of that. Trisha, Shannen, and Edmar where a fantastic point of contact and made our stay lovely. Amazing spot super close to Marina Bay Sands. Great amenities and very communicative hosts. Would def recommend and happily stay again. Clean, well laid out, not noisy (maybe I got lucky with a room at the back on level 3, not on the river) My only complaint is the washing machine only available 8am-10pm. Perfect location, easy to get around the city Easily accessible rooftop bar with a nice view of the city A very good place to stay at, close to MRTs and walking distance to sight seeings like the Merlion, also close to restaurants and shopping mall (Clark Quay mall). I will stay at heritage hotel for the next time when visiting Singapore. Nice place for an extended stay. The room was bigger than we expexted.

I would wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone looking for a place to stay in Singapore! My stay in Singapore was very comfortable and convenient. I stayed at this Airbnb for one month and absolutely loved the place. It was very clean, and the staff were incredibly friendly. Everything went smoothly, and I would definitely stay here again! Great host. Place is in close proximity to grocery shops, MRT and bus stations.
